subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Open your heart

options.text: Feel relieved because the stress is removed

solution:
The **correct answer** is **Option 2** i.e.** Share your deepest feelings.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "Open your heart" means to share your deepest feelings or thoughts with someone else. It suggests a level of trust and intimacy, allowing one to be vulnerable and open.
 
 
• **Example: **After the therapy session, I felt comfortable enough to open my heart to my therapist about my anxieties.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- '**Share your deepest feelings.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Immediately think of something** - This means to have a thought or idea come into your mind without delay. 
 
• **Option 3: Feel relieved because the stress is removed** - This refers to the feeling of relief or relaxation that comes when a source of stress or anxiety is no longer present.
 
• **Option 4: Could do something very easily** - This suggests that an action or task can be performed without much effort.
